title: Emergent Misalignment Persistence After Standard Safety Fine-Tuning on Open Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly answers whether emergent misalignment is remediable via standard safety fine-tuning. If persistent like sleeper agents, the concern is much more serious. If removable, risk is mitigated. Immediate practical relevance for model providers.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires inducing misalignment (one SFT run) then applying three separate recovery interventions (SFT, DPO, combination). DPO setup requires constructing preference pairs. Multiple training runs needed. Feasible with TRL and LoRA on medium compute but requires more experience than a pure replication.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four training runs total (induction + 3 remediations) plus evaluation. Could be narrowed by testing only 1-2 interventions. As stated, ambitious for 30 hours but doable if scoped to SFT remediation only.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
